name: Inanis
description: A spongy gray concretion formed from the residue of vis used in enchantment; it saps magical effects and the Might of supernatural creatures within its range. An optional rule for sagas exploring magical pollution.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used in enchantments; magical technology requires a plentiful supply, and spun vis can be scavenged from existing enchantments.

name: The Gift
description: The supernatural talent required to be a Hermetic magus; it carries a social penalty that makes magi employ mundane factors, and inanis is feared to destroy it.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural auras that some fear inanis might deplete.

name: Might
description: The supernatural power score of creatures; creatures lose Might while within the area of effect of inanis.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting of Ars Magica, which magical technology might transform.

name: Virgilian Magic
description: A recently discovered magical tradition with a strong element of invention through Animo, the creation of objects with awakened spirits.

name: Animo
description: The Virgilian practice of creating objects with awakened spirits that move of their own volition and adapt to their surroundings, something impossible with Hermetic magic.

name: Augustan Brotherhood
description: Practitioners of Virgilian Magic whose discoveries are less than a century old.

name: Mechanicians
description: A now-extinct magical tradition of mechanic-magicians who studied under Heron of Alexandria and infused mechanical devices with wondrous abilities; they died out in the fifth century.

name: Heron of Alexandria
description: Ancient teacher of the Mechanicians whose Mechanica describes devices producing semi-magical effects.

name: Mechanica of Heron
description: The lost teachings of Heron of Alexandria whose rediscovery would allow building semi-magical devices without vis; source of Mutable Devices.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The organization of Hermetic magi, which in this saga seed becomes a highly selective craft guild producing magical technology.

name: Charged Items
description: A lesser form of enchantment insufficient for the more spectacular magical technologies.

name: Mutable Devices
description: A discovery from Heron of Alexandria's Mechanica allowing characters to scavenge spun vis and use its capacity in new enchantments.

name: Reforging Enchanted Items
description: An Inner Mystery of House Verditius allowing spun vis from enchanted items to be reused in new enchantments.

name: House Verditius
description: Hermetic House of enchanters; in the saga seed its Outer Mystery was betrayed, it ceased to be a Mystery Cult and became a Societas, and co-located its domus magna with House Bonisagus.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House of redcaps rumored to hold a vis cache near Harco; in the saga seed its redcaps become agents for selling magical technology.

name: Harco
description: Location near which House Mercere is rumored to hide a huge vis cache.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House that punishes vis stockpiling and, in the saga seed, fought to enforce the Oath and stifle change but was defeated.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability required for preparing and enchanting items and using vis; teaching it early to apprentices could speed item manufacture.

name: Laboratory Texts
description: Written records of laboratory work that allow other magi to duplicate enchanted devices.

name: Hermetic Arts
description: The Arts of Hermetic magic; magi need sufficiently high Arts to achieve enchantments and apprentices are Opened to them.

name: Opening the Arts
description: The process by which an apprentice is Opened to the Hermetic Arts, after which they can prepare items for enchantment.

name: Apprenticeship
description: The training period of a Hermetic magus; the saga seed proposes indenturing magi afterwards to repay the Order.

name: Indenture
description: A proposed period of required seasons of labor after apprenticeship to remunerate the Order, similar to a guild journeyman phase.

name: Breakthrough
description: Discoveries in Magic Theory that can speed or ease the creation of enchantments or allow new capabilities.

name: Single-Use Charged Items
description: A Breakthrough in Magic Theory that could ease the creation of enchantments.

name: Vis-less Enchantments
description: A Breakthrough in Magic Theory allowing enchantments without vis.

name: Rune Magic
description: A Breakthrough that could revolutionize the making of enchantments.

name: Covenant
description: Home communities of magi; in a transformed Mythic Europe some resemble factories.

name: Finesse
description: Ability governing quality of Craft Magic; most magical manufacture is operated by those with little or no Finesse, producing shoddy goods.

name: Rego Craft Magic
description: Rego magic used to craft items; in the saga seed it permits rapid mass production of textiles, tools, and weapons.

name: Rego
description: The Hermetic Technique of control, used in Rego Craft Magic.

name: Learned Magicians
description: Magicians who influence luck, health, and magic with protective devices and trade in protecting buildings against magical siege engines.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House whose dominant Harmonist faction takes to adventuring in flying ships in the saga seed.

name: Harmonists
description: The dominant faction of House Bjornaer, which in the saga seed eschews Hermetic society for adventure.

name: Wilderists
description: A House Bjornaer faction seeking to claim the wilds back from humanity; dispersed in the saga seed.

name: House Criamon
description: Hermetic House that contemplates the Enigma and ignores the changes of the world.

name: The Enigma
description: The mystery contemplated by House Criamon.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House largely unchanged by technological magic, though developing a school of combat targeting magical devices.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: The Hermetic Oath that House Guernicus sought to enforce to stifle change.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House concerned with the aesthetics of technology, sponsoring art displayed through public scrying mirrors.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House that suffers from the stripping of vis from supernatural sites for technology.

name: Faerie
description: The Faerie realm, which proved particularly vulnerable to vis stripping for technology.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House particularly interested in armamentation such as siege engines and magical weapons; Craft Magic entered it through joint apprenticeships.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House polarized between those at technology's cutting edge and those refusing innovation.

name: Scrying Mirrors
description: Distant viewer devices used by rulers to address subjects and displayed publicly for art.

name: Flying Ships
description: Ships held aloft by magic used for transporting passengers and cargo in a transformed Mythic Europe.

name: Automata
description: Delicate mechanical devices in rich households performing for children.

name: Warping
description: Side effect of magic exposure; concerns over it prevented instant transportation being adopted.

name: Living Conditions
description: Game modifier for living in a city or town, halved to +1 in the saga seed thanks to food preservation.

name: Outer Mystery of House Verditius
description: The Verditius Mystery betrayed to the Order by an anonymous writer, leading to widespread Verditius Magic.

name: Verditius Magic
description: The House Verditius Mystery Virtue, learned by many magi without casting tools after the betrayal of the Outer Mystery.

name: Mystery Cult
description: An initiatory organization; House Verditius ceased to operate as one in the saga seed.

name: Initiation
description: The means by which Mystery Virtues are normally acquired, as opposed to teaching.

name: Societas
description: A Hermetic House type that is not a Mystery Cult or True Lineage; House Verditius becomes one in the saga seed.

name: Inner Mysteries
description: The secret higher Mysteries of House Verditius, still retained after its fall.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House that researches new magical applications and passes Laboratory Texts to Verditius for manufacture.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: The Order-wide Tribunal at which the Verditius primus announced co-location with Bonisagus.

name: Primus
description: Leader of a Hermetic House.

name: Domus Magna
description: The chief covenant of a Hermetic House.

name: Durenmar
description: Domus magna of House Bonisagus, where Verditius co-locates its domus magna in the saga seed.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House of hedge traditions taken over by a cabal of Rusticani in the saga seed.

name: Rusticani
description: Hermetic hedge tradition of Mechanicals practicing Craft Magic who took over House Ex Miscellanea in the saga seed.

name: Redcaps
description: Messengers of House Mercere who become mundane agents for selling magical technology.

name: Solomonic magic
description: Eastern magic of coercing spirits; breakthroughs allow spirits to serve a device's wielder.

name: Eastern magic
description: Arab and Persian magical technology channeled through spirits and sometimes powered by demons.

name: Holy Land
description: Region of warfare between Arabs and Westerners.

name: Hermetic Magic
description: The magic of the Order of Hermes, whose enchantments take a season's work and vis.

name: Laboratory
description: Where magi perform enchantment work taking at least a season.

name: Enchanted Devices
description: Hermetic enchantments forming the basis of magical technology.

name: Magical Technology
description: The use of Hermetic enchantments as technology to transform Mythic Europe.
